checkpoints.description: [1/5] Plan: (1) bump shell/script cache version to v46; (2) fix unlabeled controls in live app sources and re-sync snapshots; (3) measure performance with browser trace and apply justified optimizations; (4) show verifier snapshot freshness; (5) triage reports inbox to its cap.

impact_assessment.why: The user approved the five recommended improvements; returning browsers serve stale JS, 12 live snapshots have a11y findings, performance is unmeasured, the verifier fallback has no freshness signal, and the reports inbox is far over cap.
impact_assessment.benefits: Deploy reaches visitors, live apps are accessible, performance is evidence-based, verifier is honest about snapshot age, workspace debt is reduced.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: version/version tests and live build digests are pinned; dependency: upstream app sources and sync tool; concurrency: other sessions edit rust/ and reports/; state: many files across three repos
impact_assessment.mitigation: Work one milestone at a time with failing-first tests where practical, verify with gates and browser after each, never force push, and leave other sessions' files alone.
